{"CTAAlerts":{"TimeStamp":"2026-10-09T06:30:07","ErrorCode":"0","ErrorMessage":null,"Alert":[{"AlertId":"112148","Headline":"State/Lake Elevated Station Temporary Closure","ShortDescription":"Effective, now, the State/Lake Loop Elevated station is closed for reconstruction into 2029. Please use adjacent stations at Clark/Lake or Washington/Wabash.","FullDescription":{"#cdata-section":"

How does this affect my trip?
Effective, Monday, January 5, 2026, the State/Lake Loop Elevated station will temporarily close.

Please use the accessible Clark/Lake or Washington/Wabash stations, located within a few blocks of the State/Lake station. To transfer between the Red Line at Lake station and the Loop ‘L’ lines, use Washington/Wabash.

Why is service being changed?
The new State/Lake elevated station is scheduled to open in 2029. It will replace one of the oldest stations on the CTA rail system with a modern facility designed to improve safety, accessibility, and comfort for all riders.

How does this affect my trip?
Ashland/63rd- and Cottage Grove-bound trains will not stop at the 43rd Green Line station.

  • For 63rd-bound service from this station, take a Harlem-bound train to Indiana and transfer to a 63rd-bound train.
  • For 63rd-bound service to this station, take a 63rd-bound train to 47th and transfer to a Harlem-bound train.

Allow extra travel time.

Why is service being changed?

We are making improvements at the 43rd Green Line station.

How does this affect my trip?
The Racine Blue Line station’s auxiliary entrance/exit at Loomis will reopen Mon, Oct 5. The entrance/exit features a new ADA-compliant ramp for entry.

Enter/exit the Racine station at either the Loomis entrance/exit or the main entrance/exit located two blocks east of Loomis on Racine.

Why is service being changed?
The work at the Racine station is part of the Blue Line Forest Park Branch Rebuild project.

95th-bound Red Line trains are running, but not stopping at Wilson due to police activity.

As a result, where riders needing station Wilson, can transfer to 95th-bound service and ride back to bypassed stop at Sheridan. 

Consider other service alternatives that may serve your trip, such as nearby bus routes, or using buses to other rail lines.

These may include:

#70  Montrose

#81 Lawrence

See station personnel for further assistance, and pay attention to announcements on trains and at stations for service information.

We are working to restore service as quickly as possible. Allow extra travel time.
